```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table)

data_dir <- "." 
out_dir  <- file.path(data_dir, "processed"); dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
f_expr <- file.path(data_dir, "Raw_Data/MBC_data_collapsed_to_symbols.txt")
stopifnot(file.exists(f_expr))
```

## 1. Read the matrix

```{r read}
hdr <- fread(f_expr, skip = 1, nrows = 0)
dims <- as.integer(strsplit(readLines(f_expr, n = 2)[2], "\t")[[1]])
cat("Header declares:", dims[1], "genes x", dims[2], "samples\n")

dt <- fread(f_expr, skip = 2, fill = TRUE, header = TRUE)
dt <- dt[, 1:92]
setnames(dt, c("gene", "description", names(dt)[-(1:2)]))
dim(dt)
stopifnot(nrow(dt) == dims[1], ncol(dt) - 2 == dims[2])
### matches manuscript: 7,792 genes x 90 samples ###
```

## 2. Sample metadata (from sample ID prefix, cross-checked against sdrf)

```{r meta}
samples <- names(dt)[-(1:2)]
sex <- fifelse(grepl("^Bm", samples), "male", fifelse(grepl("^Ta", samples), "female", NA_character_))
stopifnot(!anyNA(sex), sum(sex == "male") == 37, sum(sex == "female") == 53)

meta <- data.table(sample = samples, sex = sex)
meta[, .N, by = sex]

## optional: attach age/ER/PgR from the ArrayExpress sdrf if available alongside
f_sdrf <- file.path(data_dir, "E-TABM-810.sdrf.txt")
if (file.exists(f_sdrf)) {
  sdrf <- fread(f_sdrf, check.names = FALSE)
  sdrf_u <- unique(sdrf[, .(sample = `Sample Name`,
                            age = `Characteristics [Age]`,
                            clinical_info = `Characteristics [ClinicalInformation]`)])
  meta <- merge(meta, sdrf_u, by = "sample", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  meta <- meta[match(samples, sample)]
}
meta[1:5]
```

## 3. Expression matrix

```{r matrix}
expr <- as.matrix(dt[, -(1:2)])
rownames(expr) <- dt$gene
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(expr)))   # already collapsed to unique symbols
dim(expr)
expr[1:5, 1:5]

male_id   <- meta[sex == "male",   sample]
female_id <- meta[sex == "female", sample]
```

## 4. Save outputs

```{r save}
write.table(data.frame(GeneSymbol = rownames(expr), expr, check.names = FALSE),
           file.path(out_dir, "output_Callari_expr_symbol.txt"),
           sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
fwrite(meta, file.path(out_dir, "output_Callari_metadata.txt"), sep = "\t")

saveRDS(list(expr = expr, meta = as.data.frame(meta),
             male_id = male_id, female_id = female_id,
             source = "Author-provided (Maurizio Callari), MBC_data_collapsed_to_symbols.txt",
             genes = nrow(expr), processed = Sys.Date()),
        file.path(out_dir, "Callari_processed.rds"))

list.files(out_dir)
```

sessionInfo()
